name: SuperStickyNote
desc:
Floating sticky notes over your notebooks and documents. Tap the bubble and a post-it appears; drag it, resize it, fold it, close it — it is still in the Manager.

Two kinds of notes (Settings → Mode):
• Handwriting — write on the sticky note with the pen, erase, undo. Lasso handwriting on a page to copy it into a sticky note, then write over it or erase parts of it.
• Text (OCR) — type with the keyboard; a lasso is recognised as text. PDF text selections always become text notes.
Every capture links back to its page, and any note can be put back on the page: handwriting as real strokes (notebooks and PDFs), text as an editable text box (notebooks).

Status (3.0): handwriting in sticky notes is new. It uses the notebook's own pen engine. Tested on the Manta so far. Handwriting is not searchable — use titles and labels.

Permissions:
• Read files — to read what you lasso (the strokes, the page size) and to find a capture's source page again.
• Write files — to save the .txt exports and the backup (with its handwriting) in MyStyle/Plugins/SuperStickyNote, and to put a note back on a page. The notes themselves stay in the plugin's private storage.
Nothing leaves the device: no network, no account, no tracking.
